subject: Clarify: compliance add-on tiering, evidence SLAs & pilot credit mechanics
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medcord.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance add-ons: tiering + evidence SLAs (MedCord)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — MedCord is keen to move from pilot to a paid plan but procurement flagged a few open questions that are blocking approvals:

- How do you typically structure pricing for audit-log retention (per-GB vs fixed slab)?
- For KMS/HSM, is it a seat/license, an upfront on-prem installation fee, or amortized monthly?
- We need explicit SLA language for evidence delivery (SOC report, on-demand evidence for audits). Can you confirm turnaround and what’s included?
- Does Redwood offer a limited pilot credit that offsets implementation/setup costs if we convert within 90 days?

I’ve attached a short workbook that shows expected ingest rates and a preliminary compliance scope. Procurement is on copy (procurement@medcord.com) and would like a short write-up we can include in the PO.

Appreciate a quick outline we can share internally — happy to hop on a 30-min call if easier.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Platform Ops, MedCord Health
elena.ruiz@medcord.com

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.com <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medcord.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: tiering + evidence SLAs (MedCord)

Elena — thanks for the workbook and the clear list. Looping in Laura (legal pricing) and Ben (commercial) to land specifics; quick answers below and we can follow up with a short doc.

- Audit-log retention: we offer both models. For pilots we typically recommend a per-GB monthly slab (0-1TB, 1-5TB, >5TB) because it keeps month-to-month billing predictable. For large, steady-state customers we can model a blended per-GB rate with a committed slab and a true-up cadence.

- KMS/HSM: two options. Managed KMS: pricing per-seat (key management seat with HSM-backed keys) amortized monthly; On-prem HSM appliance: one-time setup + annual maintenance. For your volumes the seat model will likely be lower TCO up-front.

- Evidence SLAs: for standard enterprise customers we commit to providing SOC2 evidence and audit-log extracts within 5 business days for routine requests; for audit escalations (regulator-driven) we offer expedited evidence packages in 48-72 hours as part of a paid evidence SLA add-on. We’ll document included artifacts (config snapshots, audit-log export, KMS attestations).

- Pilot credit: yes — we can offer a one-time implementation credit applied against the first 3 months of invoices if you convert to a 12-month commit within 90 days. Typical cap: up to $25k for pilots of your size. We can be flexible on structure (rebate vs invoice credit).

Next steps: Ben, can you draft a short pricing write-up (1 page) and a recommended option (seat vs slab) so Elena can attach to the PO? Laura, any immediate legal/terms notes we should flag for procurement?

Happy to jump on a call Wed/Thu if helpful.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — appreciate the workbook, it helped a lot. Drafting a compact option set below that you can include in the PO. Happy to revise after you review.

Option A — Predictable slab (recommended for pilot):
- Audit-log retention: monthly slab pricing (0-1TB = $1,200/mo; 1-5TB = $3,800/mo; overages $0.02/GB)
- KMS seats: $1,000/seat/month (includes HSM-backed key ops, key rotation tooling)
- Evidence SLA: standard — SOC2 + routine exports within 5 business days (no additional fee); expedited evidence SLA (48-72h) = $2,500/month
- Pilot credit: Implementation credit of $20,000 applied as invoice credit over first 3 months if you sign a 12-month commit within 90 days

Option B — Lower up-front, usage blend (for variable volume):
- Audit-log: $0.03/GB monthly, with monthly true-up and 10% discount at >10TB/month
- KMS: one-time appliance onboarding fee $45,000 + $5,000/year maintenance OR managed seat pricing as above
- Evidence SLA: pay-per-use expedited reports $1,000/request or add monthly SLA as above

Notes/asks:
- To price accurately for Option B I need baseline monthly ingest numbers from your workbook (time series is enough).
- If procurement needs SOW language I can attach a short SOW draft today; Dylan/Laura if you can review quickly I’ll send final.

Would you prefer I send this as a single-page attachment for procurement?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
